svg.title: Omen Spread: Marginalia drolleries
svg.desc: Omen Spread (1D): a manuscript page with the Tremor event card at its centre. Two Omen cards are already laid, The Braced Wall at the Root and The Long Scroll at the Branch, and a third, The Shaken Lamp, is being lifted from the fanned hand toward the empty Crown slot. Drolleries crawl the margins: a snail, a long-necked beast, vines; the Balance Rope hangs on the left and the reader's preview line is written on the right beside the face-down Backyard card.
svg.text: The Scroll House will answer it.
